text: Based on the provided evidence, the sources do not agree about the 2012 tree-cover loss on this property. The Hansen GFC data indicates a tree-cover loss of about 1.4 ha in 2012. However, the JRC GFC2020 data, which serves as an independent reference, agrees with this loss on only 49% of the area, falling short of the required 50% agreement. Therefore, the assessment status is contradicted, meaning the sources do not concur on the tree-cover loss for that year.
